notes.title: Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.5.0.0
notes.content:
[h1] Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.5.0.0    10/18/2015 [/h1]



[b] A few small changes, enjoy. [/b]



[*]Decreased distance at which skill coins and hero coins migrate towards player.Skill coins and hero coins should be less glitchy now.

[*]Hero Coins are no longer located on the HUD.Your total hero coins can be viewed on the skill screen.Having both the hero coins and the skill coins on the HUD was a little confusing to players.Hero Coins were always just meant to be a "little extra" for the dedicated Saint fans, I don't want them becoming too distracting during normal game play.For every two hundred plus hero coins you find your musket will change in appearance.

[*]Added book explaining difference between hero coins and skill coins.
Skills coins (Yellow) are used for upgrading skills. Hero Coins (Blue) change the look of your Kuna Musket based on your total.Hero coins save over when you exit Saint.



[b] To clear up some confusion.   [/b]

[*]Trigger Saint  no longer has a "perma death" mechanic, saves were brought back before full release.Saves stones are located in each of the three hub rooms throughout the game.Save stones are tall stones with scribbled glyphs on the front.Press the "F" key while standing in front of these to save your game.To load your game click the "continue" button on the main title screen



[b] A Tip [/b]

[*]Been through the tutorial rooms one too many times? When you first spawn into the game you will see a teleporter on the floor close by, shoot directly to the left of it a few times.If your shots find their target you will unlock the teleporter that takes you directly to the first hub area.



A Good Day To You All

Aaron Arcand,
Undergroundies

notes.title: Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.4.0.0
notes.content:
[h1] Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.4.0.0    10/13/2015 [/h1]


[b] A small patch including some major HUD changes and a few small bug fixes, enjoy! [/b]




[*]You can now hide/un-hide the item and score section of the HUD by pressing the Ctrl key.

[*]Item, note and book descriptions now show up on the bottom left side of the screen.

[*]The combo meter text will now show up below the health,spirit and stamina meter while HUD is hidden.

[*]Mouse read distance for notes and books has been increased.

[*]Books and notes can no longer be read while shooting or moving, descriptions popping up during battle proved to be very distracting.

[*]Added two new books to the starting hub area, one explaining the save stone and one explaining how to hide the HUD.

[*]Fixed problem with walking/running sounds, running sounds would still play even though stamina was depleted.

[*]Saint will now stop when you click “off screen” and wont get stuck in run mode.

[*]The combo leader board has been reset.Do not worry your highest combo will re-load the next time you open Saint.


I would also like to congratulate the Saint players with the top High scores and combos, Well Done!


Highest Scores

luk7nk4      6996
ccherry04      6744
FunkyD      6695


Highest Combos

FunkyD        69
Luk7nk4       68
ccherry04     50

notes.title: Trigger Saint Full Release!
notes.content:
[h1]What an exciting day,Trigger Saint is finally out of early access! [/h1]


None of this would have been possible without the Trigger Saint fans and community. When things were hard the fans were always there to keep me going, I cannot thank you enough.

In the end it isn't just about "making the game", it's about making making new friends, having fun and learning from others along the way.

Saint has been a part of my life for quite a while and it's definitely sad to bid it farewell. Be easy on him, he's new here

I would like to officially thank my fans, testers, supporters, players, family and friends for all of your help and support along the way.

 You are friggin AWESOME!

notes.title: Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.3.0.0 Full Release Tomorrow!
notes.content:
[h1] Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.3.0.0   Full Release Tomorrow! 10/8/2015[/h1]



[b] I am pleased to announce that Trigger Saint will be coming out of Early Access tomorrow around 10 A.M.!

 I also have a few more small changes for ya in this small pre-release patch. [/b]




[list]


[*] The options screen has been given a few updates, before the only screen resolutions that were available were 1920 x 1080 full screen and 1600 x 900 windowed mode. Now there is an option for windowed or full screen along with 1920 x 1080, 1600 x 900, 1366 x 768 and 1280 x 720 resolutions.

[*] For those with slower machines I have added an option for turning off the in game clouds, I don't recommend turning these off as they add to game immersion but if you are having problems with choppy game play then try turning them off, it might help.

[*] The intro story now has a voice over.

[*] The requirements for the"Trigger king" achievement have been changed from 5000 kills to 2000 kills.

[*] The achievement for a 100 kill combo has been removed.



Enjoy!

Aaron Arcand,
Undergroundies

notes.title: Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.0.9.0
notes.content:
[h1] Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.0.9.0  9/17/2015	[/h1]



[b] Combos, an all new scoring system and Steam leader boards await you in this exciting new patch!

You can expect save wipes with each new patch until release, sorry for the inconvenience.

LEADER BOARDS! [/b]





[list]


[*] SCORING SYSTEM

    I grew up playing classic games, high scores were of high importance way back when. I thought it only fair to bring a scoring system into Trigger Saint. You can now keep track of your in game score as your play through story mode, your score can be found in your HUD. You can raise your score by killing enemies,opening books, breaking chests, picking up items and doing many other things.When you die or "exit to main menu" your high score will be saved. For the time being your high score can be seen on the title screen, lower left.

But wait there's more...

[*] COMBOS

Combat in Trigger Saint is about getting into the zone, flowing like water, destroying large groups of enemies within seconds . I wanted to bring in a mechanic that would encourage players to play Saint how I originally wanted it to be played.There should be times of rest but in combat I want to encourage high speed attacks/dodges all while balancing your stamina,spirit and combo counter.
Trigger Saint is now fitted with a unique combo system, kill an enemy then kill another right after and you will start the combo counter.Glowing purple letters spelling the word "combo" will appear below your HUD "combo x1" and will continue to increase as long as you keep killing enemies in quick succession. If another enemy is not killed soon enough your meter will vanish, you will be rewarded points based on the number you reached x2 (so for a 32x combo you would receive 64 bonus points.)  It still needs some tweaking/balancing but I hope it can be a welcome addition to Saint gameplay.


And that's not all...

[*] STEAM LEADER BOARDS

Yes... you heard correct, Trigger Saint now has it's own leader boards on Steam! Whenever you die or exit to the main menu your score will be automatically uploaded to the corresponding Steam leader board.(Only if your current score is better than your previous best). You can find leader boards in the community HUB under stats. The Story Mode high scores leader board is already up and running, to get the ball rolling I have set the first official score! Let's see what you got!

More leader boards coming soon! 
Highest combo anyone?


[*] NEW ACHIEVEMENT 

I have been promising this one for a while now and it's finally here, the achievement for defeating the third boss (Blue Zone). "Trophy Kill" 
Happy Hunting!




I hope you enjoy these fun new changes to Saint, bragging rights await!

Aaron Arcand,
Undergroundies

notes.title: Emergency Patch 1.0.8.0
notes.content:
[h1] Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.0.8.0  9/14/2015	[/h1]



[b] This is an emergency patch to fix breaks in the green zone and red zone levels, to any of you who found them... I hope you had fun off in the clouds!

With the current save system saves become corrupt when I patch so saves have been wiped.I was hoping that I wouldn't have to patch this soon, I am very sorry for this inconvenience. [/b]





Besides the fixes to breaks in levels I have made a few other changes as well

[list]


[*] The static orbs in the green zone did the same amount of damage as static orbs in further levels, this has been changed. Static orbs in the green zone now only cause 2 damage.

[*] Fixed "Nuts And Bolts" depth problems.

[*] A new audio track has been added to the track list.

notes.title: Trigger Saint Mini Patch And Weekend Deal!
notes.content:
[h1] Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.0.7.0 And... Weekend Sale 65% OFF!

  9/10/2015	[/h1]


[b] This is a mini patch including some level changes, new charge animations and SAVES... yes! Saves!

To celebrate my 31st birthday Saint will be going on sale this weekend (Saturday) and will last through Sunday evening. 65% OFF! Let Them Know! [/b]




[list]

[*] Something I did not cover in the last patch, level size. As you may have noticed levels are now much bigger as far as surface area goes,more room on the battle field. From the start I wanted Saint to be about larger scale battles, taking out weaker enemies before smaller ones etc. After lots of testing I enjoy the bigger battles much more, I hope you do too.

[*] Saint now has all new charging animations, the older ones were just kind of meh, needed something a little more epic! EPIC!

[*] Small changes have been made to level 3-1 and level 3-2 has been completely re-designed. (Blue Zone)

[*] Saves are back! Woot!



Aaron Arcand ,
Undergroundies

notes.title: Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.0.6.0
notes.content:
[h1] Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.0.6.0  9/5/2015	[/h1]


[b] Greetings, I am always excited  to drop a new patch, especially when it has been a while and there are many new things to see and experience.

Lots of new artwork, new enemies and much needed changes to levels are included in this beefy patch.

This patch will be followed up by a couple smaller patches tomorrow evening that will include the save feature, an achievement for defeating the third boss and further changes to the blue zone. I hope it was worth the wait, Enjoy! [/b]




[list]


[*]Increased stamina recharge rate.

[*]Updated the skill room, no longer shows the HUD. The "Focus" and  "Override" skills have been removed, these enhancements will soon be added to two new items.

[*]Most enemies have completely new weapon sprites with hands included, they flip accordingly now just like saint's weapon.

[*] Green Zone levels 1-1 and 1-2 have been changed slightly.

[*]Red Zone levels 1-1 and 1-2 have been completely redesigned.

[*]Nuts and bolts now fly off enemies as you tear into them with your weapon.

[*]Updated player and enemy projectiles, they now have colored smoke and matching ash trails.

[*]The "Scavenger" enemies have been re-done, now come in blue, green and purple.

[*]The "Scout" Enemy artwork has been changed slightly.

[*]The "Praetor" enemy has new artwork.

[*]The "Rugetta" enemy has new artwork

[*]Added new enemy the "Breaker".These red, hot tempered enemies shoot shotgun like blasts of damaging particles.You can find them on level 1-2, Green Zone.

[*]The blue zone boss (Boss three) has been completely re-designed and has new artwork. Two smaller versions of himself now fight along side, these must now be taken out before saint can get close enough to cause damage to the bosses delicate head jewel.

[*]Added new tile props to all levels.

[*]The cross hair sprites have been changed.

[*]Added new sounds for saint's primary musket shot.

[*]The "Trigger Saint Game Guide" in the discussions section has been updated and new enemy names and descriptions have been added.






You may find a few bugs as this was a pretty large patch, make sure you report any problems/bugs you have below. Thanks!

Aaron Arcand ,
Undergroundies

notes.title: New Patch Coming Soon!
notes.content:
I am very sorry as things on Saint's end have been very hush hush.I have spent most of my time lately working on Saint and haven't had much time for anything else, patches, announcements, Twitter posts, discussion updates etc.

    You can expect a new patch within the next couple days that includes smoother game play for older machines, new enemies, new artwork and new level designs.

    I want Saint ready for full release within the next month or two so it's really crunch time. I am very excited as Saint is getting closer and closer to what I imagined it would be from the start, I hope you are too.

Aaron Arcand
Undergroundies

notes.title: Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.0.5.0
notes.content:
[h1] Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.0.5.0  7/27/2015	[/h1]


[b] Greetings, the newest saint patch is now live! I am very sorry it has been so long, it took a while to add all of the new level tiles and clouds. This patch includes some big visual changes to levels and also an intro into challenges and hero coins. Enjoy!   [/b]



[list]



[*]Skill points are now known as "Skill Coins" to prevent confusion with the new "Hero Coins" mechanics.

[*]Added a new type of rare coin, the "Hero Coin". These will now be dropped by enemies and chests randomly. You will have a higher chance of finding these on tough enemies and hard to find chests.

Most importantly these coins will "save over" when you exit the game, exit to the menu or die. Meaning that your total hero coins will save even through patches.

Your total hero coins will now determine what your musket's visual appearance, it will evolve with every fifty hero coins you can find.

Hero coins drops are random, some runs you may find many some runs you may find only a few.

Hero coins will also determine what challenge rooms will be available to you, these rooms are still under construction and will not be available until the next saint patch.

Save up those hero coins!
 The more you have come next patch the more challenge rooms will be available to you.


[*]Total kills no longer effect your musket's visual appearance.

[*] Due to heavy lag from clouds on some levels they have now been changed. Clouds were causing enough lag to make saint unplayable for some. All level clouds have been re-done and rather than being objects are now moving backgrounds, I think they look a lot better and hopefully saint will be less laggy for those having issues. If you still are having problems after this patch please let me know.

[*]All level tiles have been redone, they are much thinner now and it gives me more freedom with what I can build in levels with tiles. Expect to see much more tile/level variety in the next few patches.

[*]Saint's musket now flips when facing the other direction, it looked a bit "awkward" before.

[*]Added scrolling text to story screen.

[*]Fixed bug crash involving floating enemies in the red zone.


(Edit)

[*]The achievement "Trigger King" 10,000 lifetime kills has been reduced to 5000 kills and the "Trigger Flash" achievement has been removed.

[*}On Steam achievements now show their current progress towards total.

notes.title: Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.0.4.0
notes.content:
[h1] Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.0.4.0   7/2/201	[/h1]


[b] Finally got around to rolling out a new patch, I didn't get  to as much as I planned  but still there are a few major changes and some bug fixes here for ya.

I will be re-doing the way tiles are laid out in levels giving them a much more varied look, I wanted to update before I started with the changes as they will be pretty drastic, enjoy the patch!

 [/b]





[list]


[*]First important change, I will now be using a different program to animate. Rather than hand drawing frame by frame I will be cutting animations into pieces and animating that way, half of the enemies have already had their animations redone. They have a much more realistic look now and I'm very pleased with the end results.

[*]From the start I have wanted to emphasize the items and item lore in Trigger Saint, so.. I have made the inventory slots a bit bigger so the items are a little easier to see and have more detail. I'm still not completely sure about the HUD position but I still like them a bit bigger and it works well. Let me know what you think!

[*]Another big change, items on the ground now show up as "Gift Boxes" (small paper boxes), item identity is not revealed until you have picked up the gift box. This will help me in a few different ways and I can make a larger variety of items without being restricted by size or angle. This should also give a an interesting twist to item choice and game decisions.

[*]Trigger Saint's muskets now have a new look, the muskets before did not show hands so the musket just seemed to float there. Now the muskets have hands gripping them tightly and have a darker feel, I like the new look and I hope you do too.

[*]Added some new tiles to the green zone.

[*]Added two new items, the "Enchanted Wrist Guard" and "Spirit Beads".Spirit beads increase your max spirit by ten and the enchanted wrist guard raises your attack by two.

[*]Some have been having problems with "Cloud Lag". I have spent a while tweaking clouds/spawn times etc. and I think it is working pretty well now. Let me know if you are still having problems with this.

[*]When you select "Exit To Main Menu" in game you will now exit to the main menu instead of going all the way the the start game screen.

[*]Other small bug fixes, changes and optimizations.



"Coming Soon" 

[*] More new enemy animations.
[*] A new look to levels.
[*] A challenge mode, with unlock-able challenges.

notes.content:
[h1] Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.0.1.0 AKA the "Blue Patch"  5/27/2015	[/h1]

[*]Many small bug fixes and changes.


(Edit)

[*]Fixed depth problems with teleporters in tutorial areas.

[*]Fixed problem with teleporter on level 2-2 being invisible when not activated.

[*]Added four new journals.

notes.title: Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.0.0.9
notes.content:
[h1] Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.0.0.9  5/9/2015	[/h1]


[b] Another small patch covering small issues and bugs, many thanks for all of the recent feedback and suggestions. Enjoy!	[/b]



[list]


[*]Player must now be stationary in order to regain stamina. 

[*]Changed the increase/decrease speed of stamina.

[*]Fixed depth problems with floor mines/bullets.

[*]Changed story screen font.

[*]Exit game button will no longer show up twice if player dies with menu open.

[*]Circle of stones has new artwork

[*]Teleporters and circle of stones no longer have sparkle animations. Teleporters now blink green when activated, circle of stones purple.

[*]Added hidden scenery objects.

[*]Fixed problem with Boss Two's cross-hair not following player when charging to the left.


(Edit)

[*]The story screen now has a longer timer and can also be skipped by pressing (Enter,Space or Left Click).

[*]Saint build number and note on saves being disabled is now visible on the title screen as requested.

[*]Exe. build number has been fixed and now reads 1.0.0.9.

[*]Removed "Speed Beans" from levels as they feel pretty useless after the other stamina changes.

[*]Increased "Circle Of Stones" size.

[*]Chests can now be destroyed with one hit from your secondary attack.


(Edit)

I have added  alternate control keys for running and charging.

[*]Middle Mouse can now be used to "Spirit Charge".

[*]Space Bar can now be used to Run/Sprint.

[*] I have moved the items,enemies and Kuna Modules sections from the Trigger Saint Lore post to the new Trigger Saint Guide post.

notes.title: Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.0.0.8
notes.content:
[h1] Trigger Saint Patch Notes 1.0.0.8       5/5/2015	[/h1]


[b]     A somewhat small patch, fixing some serious problems/bugs.
Also a few changes and some level tweaking.   [/b]


    After some testing and talking with players I have found a serious issue regarding the player taking damage and enemy contact.

    Players making contact with enemies would get stuck, draining their health completely and killing them. A very unfair way to die indeed.

    This has been fixed, I have reworked the way the player takes damage.You will now be able to continue moving/shooting while being attacked and when you take damage your player will indicate he is hurt by flashing along with an audio cue.

    I know this must have been frustrating and I hope this fix makes for a better Saint experience .



[list]

[*]Fixed problems with room fade transition memory leaks/lag.

[*]Poison smoke has been removed for the time being.

[*]Smoker enemies have been re-designed and are now called "Forged Faces"
These shield like enemies act as front line tanks soaking up most projectiles and protecting those behind.

[*]Obstacle orbs will now explode when you make contact. Player will no longer get stuck on these and die.

[*]Made some small changes to level 2-1.

[*]Added two new journals.

[*]Added new achievements,
"In my sights" Kill the Green Zone boss.
"A Skilled Hunter" Kill the Red Zone boss.
"Master Of Transmutation" Transmute 500 items
